blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Yaletown is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 335 homes sold there: 320 condos and 15 townhomes. 320 condos sold in Yaletown with a median price of $853,000 (the middle half sold between $654,050 and $1,190,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 6% sold above list.
Yaletown home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

320 condos sold in Yaletown with a median price of $853,000 (the middle half sold between $654,050 and $1,190,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $1,042 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median strata fee of $644 a month. 15 townhomes sold in Yaletown with a median price of $1,454,500 (the middle half sold between $1,187,500 and $2,309,844), taking a median of 39 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $1,086 per square foot, a median year built of 2001 and a median strata fee of $1,141 a month.

items.t: Yaletown is a Greater Vancouver REALTORS® sub-area and a district of Downtown on the north side of False Creek; it is not itself one of the City's 22 local areas, where Downtown is listed.
The City says the 1900 warehouse district was bounded by Nelson, Homer, Drake and Pacific Streets, and the revitalized section lies north of Pacific Boulevard between Nelson and Drake.

The Yaletown Historic Area (HA-3) schedule caps height at 21.4 m (or existing height if greater) and floor space ratio at 5.00, with dwellings limited to 3.0; there is no residential use on the ground floor.
HA-3 aims to convert old warehouses and fit new buildings to circa-1900 proportions.
Nearby Downtown South is planned as a high-density residential and mixed-use area under the Downtown Official Development Plan, amended by Council in 1991.

blocks.text: Yaletown: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The City parks map labels Emery Barnes Park, David Lam Park and Yaletown Park; it gives no facility details.
Roundhouse Community Arts and Recreation Centre is in Yaletown, with a gymnasium, studios, a 200-seat theatre and the Engine 374 locomotive.
The City names Granville and Davie Streets as Downtown South's main retail strips and recognizes Yaletown's loading docks and canopies as a heritage feature.
Elsie Roy Elementary, 150 Drake Street; VSB describes it as full, with about 430 students and some catchment students on a waitlist.
TransLink lists Yaletown-Roundhouse on the Canada Line, between Vancouver City Centre and Olympic Village.

blocks.text: Yaletown: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: The City lists portions of False Creek North, including Yaletown, as flood-exposed from sea level rise, with over $19 billion of assessed value in the False Creek floodplain.
The Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy applies citywide to rezoning and development permit applications affecting renters.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% of assessed value for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did condos in Yaletown sell for?
faq.a: 320 condos sold in Yaletown from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $853,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Yaletown?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Yaletown sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 320 condos that sold in Yaletown went for between $654,050 and $1,190,000, around a median of $853,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Yaletown sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 320 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Yaletown?
faq.a: Of the 320 sales, 320 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $644.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Yaletown?
faq.a: The median year built was 2003 for the 320 condos sold in Yaletown.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Yaletown usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Yaletown had 2 bedrooms, from the 320 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
